problem: The product is now understandable, discoverable, and visually coherent, but the laboratories are still primarily free-play surfaces. Users need optional progressive exercises that explain what to accomplish, validate the real workbench result, preserve freedom, and record learning progress without introducing artificial locks.
learning_contract: every laboratory exposes an optional practice surface while preserving free play
all 13 laboratories define Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced exercises
39 exercises validate actual runtime or rendered state rather than button clicks alone
hints and reference solutions are available without automatically completing work
Challenge mode suppresses assistance without changing lab functionality
exercise completion persists locally per lab and difficulty
laboratory discovery surfaces expose 0/3 through 3/3 progress without locking any lab
a recommended learning path covers Labs 01 through 12 while allowing arbitrary navigation
Markdown structured-practice grading preserves the canonical in-memory completion engine while bridging authored semantic structure into the real rendered preview
recommended-path activation is deferred out of the originating button event so the underlying lab navigation receives a normal activation turn
all v1.2.0, v1.1.0, v1.0.1, and P12 certification gates remain mandatory
promotion_rule: Promote only after both the historical regression workflow and v1.3.0 learning workflow pass on the metadata-complete candidate head.
